tagline: Creating environments and experiences that inspire teams and customers to achieve more together.
hero_kpi_rationale: Dividend per share is the primary indicator of the company's ability to return value to shareholders, reflecting financial health and capital distribution strategy in the real estate sector.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount of dividend paid per ordinary share.
kpis.description: Indicates capital return policy to investors. Indicator tracked annually by company analysts; historical data over the past 5 years.

kpis.name: Fixed-Rate Debt
kpis.explanation: Total amount of debt bearing interest at fixed rates.
kpis.description: Represents the company's exposure to interest rate changes on its debt.

kpis.name: Unhedged Variable-Rate Debt
kpis.explanation: Amount of variable-rate debt not protected by hedging instruments.
kpis.description: Indicates company sensitivity to interest rate fluctuations on unhedged debt.
kpis.signal: Decrease in variable rate risk exposure.

kpis.name: Interest Expense Impact (100bps)
kpis.explanation: Annual variation in interest expense for a 100 basis point change in interest rates.
kpis.description: Quantifies potential impact of interest rate changes on financial expenses.

kpis.name: Fair Value Fixed Debt Impact (100bps)
kpis.explanation: Variation in fair value of fixed-rate debt for a 100 basis point change in interest rates.
kpis.description: Measures sensitivity of fixed-rate debt fair value to interest rate changes.
kpis.signal: Significant impact on fixed debt fair value.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €6.27 billion in most recent year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €3.55 billion in most recent year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.03 billion in most recent year

kpis.name: Equity Distribution Agreements
kpis.explanation: Agreements enabling the sale of ordinary shares through agents.
kpis.description: These agreements allow the company to raise capital by issuing new shares in the market.

risks.title: Dependency on Distributions
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on distributions to finance its activities, which can be affected by board decisions.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks related to rental defaults and potential credit losses.

risks.title: Market Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to real estate and financial market fluctuations, which may affect its debt refinancing ability and investment capacity.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to regulations and laws that may change and impact its operations.

risks.title: Liquidity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company may face liquidity challenges if unable to refinance debt or complete investments.

risks.title: Asset Depreciation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to depreciation risks on its real estate assets, which may affect its value and financial results.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate risks, which may affect its financing costs and financial results.
